answer: Validator reputation is the scarce gate: each new identity needs endorsements from validators in at least three separate orchard clusters, invite subtrees sharing no ancestor. A registry records every endorser, so any validator can check that an inlet panel spans three clusters; a panel from fewer is rejected. An honest agent pays once: a 2-unit fee and three checks. A farm making 1,000 fakes cannot reuse one panel: each fake needs three fresh endorsements, 3,000 total, and a validator endorsing linked panels gets an umber flag and loses standing when overlap is proven from registry data.
